title: Talent Specialist
description:
Talent Advisor & Specialist – Strategic Pharmaceutical RPO

As a Talent Advisor & Specialist , you will be the primary point of contact for full-cycle recruitment in Brazil within a high-performance RPO model. Partnering with hiring managers at a world-leading biopharmaceutical company , you will recruit for mission-critical, high-science roles.

This is a consultative role for a recruiter who acts as a strategic bridge between candidate excellence and complex business needs. You will operate in a "white-glove" environment where market intelligence and senior stakeholder management are just as important as the hire itself.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Niche Recruitment: Ownership of the full recruitment lifecycle for highly specialized roles, including Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs) , HCP Partners , Clinical Research, and senior leadership.
  • Strategic Stakeholder Management: Act as a consultative partner for global hiring managers (US/Europe). Lead intake meetings, define sourcing strategies, and provide market data to influence hiring decisions.
  • Market Mapping & Hunting: Proactively identify and engage passive, high-level talent within the neurology, immunology, and rare disease sectors.
  • Candidate Experience & Logistics: Manage a premium candidate journey, from initial engagement through offer negotiation and pre-boarding.
  • Performance Excellence: Ensure alignment with aggressive KPIs, including a 10-day shortlist target and a 30-day average Time-to-Fill .

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of full-cycle recruitment experience, ideally within an RPO or executive search environment.
  • Industry Expertise: Direct experience recruiting for Pharmaceutical or Life Sciences companies is highly preferred (understanding roles like MSL or Regulatory Affairs is a major advantage).
  • Bilingual Communication: Fluency in both Portuguese and English is mandatory for reporting to and collaborating with global stakeholders.
  • Seniority: Proven ability to manage the recruitment of Director-level and highly technical scientific profiles.
  • Tools: Mastery of LinkedIn Recruiter and global ATS systems (Workday, SuccessFactors, or Gupy).

Compensation & Work Model

  • Base Salary: R$9,000.00 (Monthly CLT).
  • Model: Hybrid (Barra Funda, São Paulo). Requires on-site presence twice a week.
  • Benefits: Complete corporate benefits package.

Why You’ll Succeed

  • Global Visibility: Operate within a strategic, multi-market RPO model with direct exposure to international leadership.
  • Specialized Impact: Build the teams responsible for delivering life-changing medications in Neurology and Immunology.
  • Defined Performance: Work in an environment with clear SLAs and data-driven success, where your efficiency is recognized and measured.
  • Career Growth: Join a long-standing, stable account with significant investment in professional development.

Randstad is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Analista de CRM

Obrigatórios

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento de B1 dados mestres e processos de Ordem/Entrega/Faturamento.
  • Experiência com linguagens de integração, OData, JSON, XML.
  • Certificações SAP CX.

title: Analista de Carreira e Sucessão Sênior
description:

  • Estruturar e implementar o processo de avaliação de potencial corporativo, envolvendo lideranças e posições estratégicas.
  • Desenvolver e sustentar o planejamento sucessório, iniciando por posições-chave e escalando o modelo por ondas de implementação.
  • Conduzir a implantação e utilização do Nine Box, garantindo critérios claros, análises consistentes e suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Atuar de forma integrada ao subsistema de desempenho já existente, cruzando dados de performance com potencial e carreira.
  • Apoiar a implementação e evolução da política de carreira, garantindo clareza de critérios, requisitos e possibilidades de crescimento.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência sólida em Desenvolvimento Humano e Organizacional (DHO), com foco em gestão de carreira, avaliação de potencial, desempenho e sucessão.
  • Vivência na estruturação e implementação de processos de RH, preferencialmente em empresas de médio ou grande porte.
  • Experiência com metodologias de avaliação de potencial, como Nine Box ou frameworks similares.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com domínio de Excel e análise de dados, incluindo elaboração de relatórios, indicadores e dashboards para suporte à tomada de decisão.

  • Desejável experiência com sistemas de gestão de pessoas, especialmente módulos de desempenho, carreira e sucessão (diferencial: conhecimento em SUCS).

Sobre a FESA Group:

Fundada em 1995, a FESA Group é uma empresa brasileira que apoia organizações em toda a jornada estratégica de gestão de pessoas: do recrutamento executivo ao desenvolvimento de lideranças e à transformação cultural. Referência em seu setor de atuação, combina inteligência de mercado, especialização setorial e tecnologia, tendo a felicidade corporativa como parte essencial do seu DNA.

Seu portfólio integrado oferece soluções sob medida para aquisição, desenvolvimento, sucessão e retenção de talentos, sempre com foco no cliente e na entrega de resultados que geram impacto real nos negócios e na vida das pessoas. Mais do que autoridade nos setores em que atua — como Agronegócio, Indústria, Energia e Infraestrutura, Mercado Financeiro e Varejo —, conta com consultores especialistas preparados para criar conexões humanas que impulsionam crescimento e transformação.

Com presença em todo o Brasil por meio de escritórios regionais e atuação internacional via IIC Partners, presente em mais de 30 países, a FESA Group alia alcance global à expertise local. No campo social, o Instituto FESA C.R.O.M.A promove programas de voluntariado voltados à educação e qualificação profissional de jovens em situação de vulnerabilidade, reforçando seu compromisso com uma sociedade mais inclusiva e sustentável.

description:

HIL Validation Engineer

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) validation for Body domain ECUs using dSPACE HIL systems (PHS/Scalexio).
  • Connect ECUs, sensors, and actuators to LabCar; manage wiring harness and breakout box testing.
  • Commission HIL rigs and debug hardware/software integration issues.
  • Develop HIL test specifications, create test cases, procedures, and reports.
  • Automate HIL tests using Python or CAPL scripting.
  • Analyze failures and perform root cause analysis in test environments.
  • Ensure compliance with Agile process, V&V lifecycle, and ASPICE standards.

  • Hands-on experience with dSPACE HIL hardware (ControlDesk, AutomationDesk, ConfigurationDesk).
  • Knowledge of CAN/LIN protocols, UDS services, and ECU diagnostics.
  • Familiarity with CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape for communication setup and analysis.
  • Strong debugging skills for ECU functional software and HIL environment.
  • Experience in test automation frameworks and scripting (Python/CAPL).
  • Requirement management tools: DOORS, PREEVision.
  • Ability to work in Agile teams and communicate effectively with stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in: - Electronics / Electrical / Instrumentation / Computer Science Engineering or equivalent.
  • 2–9 years of experience required (Mid to Advanced level)
  • Preferred Skill:
  • • Experience in BCM validation or HVAC system testing.
  • • Knowledge of CAN-FD, FlexRay, Ethernet.
  • • Understanding of HIL simulator models (dSPACE) and ARXML models.
  • • Exposure to multi-ECU HIL setups and integration testing.
  • Tools & Technologies:
  • dSPACE: ControlDesk, AutomationDesk, ConfigurationDesk.
  • Vector tools: CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape.
  • MATLAB/Simulink for plant modeling.
  • Requirement tools: DOORS, RTC.
  • Debugging tools: Trace32, Wireshark.
  • Protocols:
  • CAN
  • LIN
  • FlexRay
  • Ethernet
  • UDS (ISO14229)

Salary: 10,000/ BRL

title: Especialista de Parcerias e Aplicações - CO Brasília
description:
Somos a Copa Energia, uma empresa brasileira, referência em soluções energéticas e à frente das próximas inovações do setor para construir um amanhã melhor a partir de uma matriz energética mais limpa.

Através das nossas duas marcas, Copagaz e Liquigás, respondemos por 25% da distribuição de Gás Liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP) do Brasil. Possuímos operações em 25 estados e Distrito Federal e cerca de 90 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos. Sendo a maior empresa no segmento de GLP da América Latina. Somos uma empresa privada, que está presente em milhares de lares desde os anos 50. Além disso, fazemos parte do seleto grupo de investidas ItauSA.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista de Parcerias e Aplicações - CO Brasília para fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Atuar como a autoridade técnica em Transição Energética da companhia, desenhando soluções customizadas que integrem o portfólio de GLP, GNL e Biometano. Sua missão é liderar a estratégia técnica de acesso a novos mercados, apoiando os Key Accounts na estruturação de propostas complexas que garantam a melhor escolha energética para o cliente (técnica, econômica e ambiental) e maximizem a rentabilidade da companhia. Os especialistas também terão papel fundamental na formação do time de consultores KA.

  • Realizar diagnósticos técnicos estruturados da matriz energética dos clientes, avaliando performance atual, eficiência térmica e oportunidades de substituição de combustíveis;
  • Atuar em reuniões com o Key Account como especialista de aplicação, esclarecendo aspectos técnicos e garantindo assertividade na recomendação da solução;
  • Traduzir informações técnicas em insumos objetivos para suportar a decisão comercial, sem assumir papel de condução da negociação;

title: Chief Legal Officer
description:
Gold & Aron Conseil is an executive search company. We are recruiting a CLO on behalf of our client.

Our client is a growing Brazilian fintech with strong social impact and evolving from a startup into a disciplined, institutional-grade organization. In order to accelerate growth even more, the firm is seeking a Chief Legal Officer . The Ideal candidate is someone who can lead all legal related initiatives, navigate complex landscapes, build & manage a high performing team, serve as a trusted advisor to the founders and get things done (not as an advisor but as a legal executive-operator).

Responsibilities

  • Manage all legal matters (mostly domestic but some international exposure as well).
  • Build, structure, and lead a high-performing in-house legal team, including: (i) Defining clear scopes between in-house vs. external counsel; (ii) Hiring, developing, and, when necessary, upgrading talent; (iii) Implementing SLAs, prioritization frameworks, and legal intake processes; (iv) Ensuring legal is a force multiplier, not a bottleneck
  • Process Professionalization: Transition the legal department from "startup mode" to a disciplined "financial institution standard".
  • Risk Optimization: Translate legal constraints into business options. Quantify downside, propose alternatives, and recommend paths that maximize long-term enterprise value
  • Regulatory: Manage the process of applying for SCD (Sociedade de Crédito Direto) License, exposure to Central Bank of Brazil (BCB), Open Finance, Consumer protection at scale (BACEN + SENACON dynamics), Structuring new financial products under regulatory ambiguity
  • Be ready to contribute to potential capital raise/M&A processes, manage data rooms, oversee due diligence, and negotiate complex term sheets.

Qualifications

  • 15–20 years of experience.
  • Ideal candidate will bring a generalist expertise being able to navigate Brazilian Employment law, Tax basics, Contract law (Brazil & International), Regulatory, M&A.
  • Ideal candidate has a combination of top-tier law firm and in-house
  • Start-up experience (ideally at a Fintech)
  • Proven People Leadership
  • Language: English fluency is a must.
  • Location: São Paulo. (Hybrid work environment)

This role is NOT for:

  • Pure advisory profiles who prefer external counsel to execution
  • Lawyers who have not personally built, hired, and performance-managed teams
  • Professionals uncomfortable making fast risk trade-offs with imperfect information
  • Candidates who need heavy structure before acting

Disponibilidade para turnos;

Residir em Olímpia, Severínia, Cajobi ou Baguaçu/SP.

Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

  • Liderar e executar o roadmap estratégico de Data Science e AI, desenvolvendo produtos internos que irão revolucionar nossa operação e a forma como entregamos valor.
  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de vida dos projetos (end-to-end), desde a concepção e coleta de dados (Engenharia de Dados) até o deployment e monitoramento dos modelos (MLOps).

  • Criar modelos de machine learning para resolver desafios de negócios, como: previsão de performance de campanhas, sistemas de recomendação de influenciadores (matchmaking), análise de sentimento em larga escala e detecção de tendências.

  • Apresentar resultados e descobertas complexas de forma clara e acionável para stakeholders (lideranças e equipes não técnicas).

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de Data Science e Machine Learning, com um portfólio de projetos aplicados.
  • Proficiência em Python e suas principais bibliotecas de dados (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn).
  • Experiência prática com frameworks de Deep Learning (ex: TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções com LLMs (Large Language Models), fine-tuning, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e ferramentas como LangChain ou similares.
  • Conhecimento sólido em SQL e experiência prática com bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais.
  • Experiência em engenharia de dados, construção de pipelines (ETL) e orquestração de jobs (ex: Airflow).
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita, com capacidade de "traduzir" o técnico para o negócio.

  • Experiência com plataformas de nuvem (GCP, AWS ou Azure) e suas ferramentas de AI/ML.

Diferenciais (Qualificações Desejáveis):

  • Experiência prévia em empresas do mercado Publicitário, MarTech ou Marketing de Influência.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de MLOps (ex: MLflow, Kubeflow) e deploy de modelos (ex: Docker, Kubernetes).

description:
Acreditamos que um time diverso é mais capaz de gerar valor e ser resiliente, por isso nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas. Vem ser Iguatemi! A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 14 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 3 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.

⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO

Fortalecer a área como um pilar estratégico dentro do Grupo Iguatemi, consolidando sua posição como uma das referências formais em inovação.

Garantir o NOI dos shoppings e o EBITDA corporativo por meio de uma curadoria assertiva de lojas e marcas para todos os malls e para o Iguatemi 365, orientando as decisões a partir dos quatro pilares da área: inteligência, inovação, planejamento e relacionamento.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

Fazer o planejamento anual dos shoppings para definição das prioridades estratégicas (principais oportunidades e desafios), diagnóstico do mix ideal de lojas, mapeamento de marcas (considerando posicionamento, faixa etária e estilo) e vocação, sempre alinhadas com as principais tendências globais e que possuem sinergia com o nosso negócio;

Desenvolver operações exclusivas para os shoppings do grupo e garantir o diferencial e melhor experiência para o consumidor, além da integridade dos corredores estratégicos, áreas que definem a identidade e posicionamento de cada shopping representando parte dos atributos que compõem e reforçam a marca Iguatemi;

Desenvolver estudos de grupos econômicos para analisar presença geográfica das marcas, verificar oportunidades em nossos malls, possíveis parcerias com outros empreendedores, infrações cometidas, além de mapear pleitos e concessões;

Desenvolvimento de agenda estratégica de grupos econômicos com o objetivo de formar negociações e repassar decisões para equipe comercial elaborar propostas. Além disso, a gerência é responsável por definir também as estratégicas de expansão dos lojistas considerando as informações do acompanhamento da performance de vendas e visitas mensais à concorrência.

Garantir o atingimento do NOI / receita dos seus shoppings através da efetividade das iniciativas propostas no PIX e desdobradas no 5YP e 3YP com trocas de lojas efetivas (sales spread positivo), participação ativa no orçamento anual dos shoppings, curva de entrada e saída de lojas, definição de allowance e expectativa de vendas.

Garantir o atingimento trimestral em ABL por shopping projetado no pipeline de assinaturas e acompanhar a taxa de ocupação divulgada para o mercado, além de fazer a gestão do plano de ação para locação das áreas por meio de contrato de leasing/mídia semanalmente em recop e garantir a abertura da operação para que não ocorra impacto negativo na receita líquida.

Analisar as pesquisas por categoria do share (faturamento) que cada um dos shoppings ocupa em relação aos seus concorrentes diretos, oportunidade de crescimento do ticket médio e perfil dos clientes por renda, para a melhor tomada de decisão na estratégia de fortalecimento das categorias com marcas fortes que seja atrativo para o cliente alvo.

Avaliar a exposição em ABL, receita e vendas para marcas internacionais nos shoppings únicos (Iguatemi São Paulo, JK e Brasília) e garantir o melhor equilibrio nos contratos comerciais.

Definir vocação, mix ideal e planejar as lojas por categoria e segmento dos greenfields e expansões, além de elaborar junto com a arquitetura e engenharia as plantas e acompanhar / comercializar as lojas junto com a área comercial.

Realizar reuniões frequentes (aquecimento de lead) com lojistas para garantir gestão do portfólio e melhores negociações comerciais (leasing spread positivo, coparticipação, exclusividade, etc).

Realizar a curadoria de marcas para o Iguatemi 365 e garantir equilíbrio no mix de produtos dentro de suas categorias.

OBSERVAÇÕES

Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Economia, Marketing, Moda, Comunicação, Engenharia, Design.

Pós Graduação em Marketing, Moda, Varejo (diferencial)

title: Engenheiro de Dados Pleno
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados para integrar nosso time responsável pela evolução de uma plataforma Data Lakehouse na AWS . Essa pessoa terá papel fundamental na integração de dados de múltiplas fontes, na orquestração de pipelines confiáveis e na disponibilização de camadas analíticas performáticas para consumo via Amazon Redshift e Power BI .

  • Colaborar com analistas e times de negócio, traduzindo necessidades em datasets, KPIs e camadas consumíveis, além de documentar catálogos e contratos de dados.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida em AWS : S3, Glue Data Catalog, Airflow (preferencialmente MWAA), DAGs em Python, Amazon Redshift.
  • Linguagens: Python e SQL avançado .
  • Power BI : modelagem semântica, DAX, incremental refresh, gateway, boas práticas para consumo de Redshift.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura Data Lakehouse , formatos colunares (Parquet), partições e metadados.
  • Boas práticas de engenharia: Git, testes, code reviews, documentação, pipelines confiáveis.
  • Segurança e governança: IAM, criptografia, princípios de mínimo privilégio, LGPD aplicada a dados.

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services.   • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

Domínio em interpretação e análise de dados , aplicando técnicas de exploração, visualização, identificação de padrões/tendências e storytelling para gerar insights acionáveis;

Proficiência em linguagens de programação DAX, M e SQL , para criação de métricas, consultas otimizadas e manipulação de dados em diferentes bancos de dados;

Experiência com múltiplas fontes de dados como flows, Excel, SharePoint e bancos de dados relacionais;

title: Executivo(a) de Vendas Jr. (Pet Food)
description:

A Barentz é uma distribuidora líder global de ingredientes de alto desempenho para ciências biológicas. title: Country Manager, Brazil
description:
A  Hellotext é a plataforma de marketing conversacional e automação que impulsiona vendas para algumas das marcas de e-commerce mais ambiciosas da América Latina. Com uma base de clientes em rápido crescimento, estamos expandindo nossa presença país por país —  e o Brasil é a próxima grande prioridade .

Esta não é uma posição de suporte ou pré-vendas.

Você será  a liderança comercial da Hellotext no Brasil , com foco absoluto em  vendas enterprise, abertura de mercado e geração de receita .

Sua missão

Construir e escalar a operação comercial da Hellotext no Brasil , fechando as primeiras contas estratégicas, abrindo relacionamento com líderes C-Level e estabelecendo a empresa como referência em marketing conversacional para e-commerce e varejo enterprise.

Você será responsável por  gerar, qualificar e fechar negócios , além de criar as bases para o crescimento futuro do país.

O que você fará

  • Liderar o  go-to-market comercial da Hellotext no Brasil , com foco em vendas B2B enterprise.
  • Prospectar, desenvolver e  fechar negócios com marcas médias e enterprise de e-commerce e varejo.

  • Conduzir reuniões executivas, apresentações comerciais e  negociações complexas .
  • Adaptar o discurso comercial, posicionamento e narrativa da Hellotext para o mercado brasileiro (PT-BR).
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com Produto e Marketing para levar feedback real de mercado e influenciar roadmap.
  • Representar a Hellotext presencialmente em São Paulo, Rio, BH, Porto Alegre e outras praças estratégicas.
  • Criar as bases para futura contratação e estruturação do time local (vendas, CX, parcerias).

O que você traz

  • Experiência comprovada vendendo SaaS, MarTech ou soluções digitais para e-commerce ou varejo no Brasil.
  • Histórico real de  fechamento de negócios (não apenas geração de leads).
  • Conforto total em conversar, negociar e vender para  nível C-Level e diretoria .
  • Forte capacidade de conduzir ciclos de venda consultivos e de alto valor.
  • Português nativo e inglês intermediário-avançado.
  • Mentalidade de dono: autonomia, responsabilidade e execução sem microgestão.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens (~25%) dentro do Brasil.
Diferenciais (nice-to-have)
  • Deals fechados acima de  USD 30k ARR .
  • Rede ativa de contatos em e-commerce, varejo, plataformas ou ecossistemas digitais.
  • Experiência sendo o  primeiro representante comercial de uma empresa no país.
  • Vivência ajudando a estruturar times ou processos comerciais.

Competências que valorizamos

  • Venda enterprise e negociação executiva .
  • Storytelling C-Suite — traduz valor de negócio, não features.
  • Prospecção estratégica — menos volume, mais impacto.
  • Forte senso de ownership sobre receita, pipeline e resultados.
  • Capacidade de aprender rápido, testar abordagens e construir playbooks do zero.

Por que a Hellotext?

  • Produto líder, focado 100% em comércio eletrônico latino-americano.
  • Papel fundacional com impacto direto na estratégia e crescimento do Brasil.
  • Autonomia real para construir o mercado local.
  • Cultura de execução, transparência e responsabilidade.
  • Trabalho remoto no Brasil, com verba para coworking e visitas a clientes.

title: Kitchen Sales Designer
description:
About the job

We are looking for a talented Kitchen Sales Designer to join our growing team in Latin America. In this role, you’ll help homeowners create kitchens that are both beautiful and practical. You bring a passion for design, sales, and innovation — always keeping the customer at the center. Together with experienced colleagues, you’ll thrive in a dynamic, creative environment.

What is CORNER Renovation?

CORNER is a kitchen brand dedicated to designing and manufacturing high-quality custom kitchens for homeowners worldwide. As a technology-driven company, we develop our own tools to make renovation seamless. With a distributed team in Ukraine and Argentina, and a growing presence across Latin America, we’re expanding quickly and looking for new talent to join us.

Our mission is simple: to help people create the living spaces they dream of. If that resonates with you, we’d love to welcome you to our team.

Requirements:

  • Strong sense of our style, with the ability to translate it into innovative, next-level designs that combine functionality and aesthetics.
  • Must have fluent/Advanced English
  • Flexibility to work with clients across different time zones
  • Experience with SketchUp and V-ray 
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, able to drive projects forward independently while maintaining high standards.
  • Good understanding of cabinet construction, hardware and assembly, ensuring designs are practical and production-ready.
  • Proven experience in client-facing roles, with the ability to build trust and guide clients through decision-making
  • 5+ years of work experience in the furniture and kitchen design industry
  • Knowledge of 3ds Max/Corona is a plus

Responsibilities:

  • Own the entire project cycle, from company presentation to final design.
  • Keep yourself fully updated on our product range, features, and capabilities, while exploring innovative ways to apply them in design solutions.
  • Develop kitchen and other space designs based on details collected from clients.
  • Conduct online meetings with new and existing clients to understand their requirements.
  • Prepare layouts and design presentations for clients.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.

Responsibilities

Sales Operations

  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data

Services Operations

  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems

CRM and Systems Administration

  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards

Data and Reporting

  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Contracts

  • Track and respond to internal questions regarding contract terms, pricing, and commercial conditions, partnering closely with Finance and Legal as needed.
  • Support contract lifecycle management by monitoring stated terms and addressing internal stakeholder inquiries to ensure accuracy and compliance.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - Motrice - Soluções ESG
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

A Motrice é uma empresa especializada em soluções agroindustriais inovadoras e agregadoras de valor para gestão ambiental e economia circular, com percepção e foco no potencial de também transformar resíduos orgânicos urbanos em produtos de alto valor agregado. Utilizando tecnologias limpas e processos acelerados, a empresa desenvolve rá sistemas capazes de converter resíduos em fertilizantes e regeneradores de solo de forma muito mais rápida e eficiente do que a compostagem tradicional, além de oferecer alternativas economicamente mais viáveis que o envio para aterros sanitários. Sua atuação integra princípios ESG, promovendo redução de impactos ambientais, reaproveitamento inteligente de resíduos e apoio à regeneração dos solos, contribuindo diretamente para cidades mais sustentáveis e cadeias produtivas de baixo carbono. A Motrice possui em Curitiba uma Planta Piloto equipada para dar pleno suporte ao desenvolvimento do projeto.

Projeto: Soluções ESG.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo em Bioengenharia, Bioinformática, Bioquímica , Biologia , Engenharia de Processos, Engenharia Química, Agronomia ou áreas correlatas

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Principais Atividades:

  • Desenvolvimento, testes e validação da engenharia de processos, utilizando conhecimentos de física, química e biologia;
  • Estruturar indicadores técnicos e econômicos, mapear possibilidades de escalabilidade e apoiar estratégias de inclusão de catadores, educação ambiental e redesenho de arranjos produtivos locais.

Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos

  • Desenvolvimento de processos físico, químico e biológicos, avaliação agronômica, gestão de resíduos sólidos urbanos, inclusão produtiva

Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais

  • Design de experimentos (DOE), modelagem de processos, análise de ciclo de vida (ACV), arranjos produtivos locais (APL), capacitação técnica e integração social

Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho : Híbrido – Curitiba/PR (integração e sempre que houver atividade de laboratório)

Soft Skills : Liderança, Autonomia, Pensamento Crítico, Ética e Responsabilidade.

title: Geólogo(a) Exploração Pleno
description:

Sobre a Oportunidade

Responder pela execução de trabalhos de natureza geológica, sondagens, amostragens, mapeamento, modelamento, estimativa e interpretações geológicas, englobando a conceituação inicial, desenvolvimento até a realização do projeto, mapeamento geológico e amostragem (subsolo e superfície), contribuindo para avaliação do potencial aurífero das áreas, para as operações de extração e que resultem na expansão da reserva mineral e manutenção dos alvarás de pesquisa e lavra concedidos..

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Executar atividades de mapeamento e amostragens relacionadas a programas de pesquisa mineral e liderar tecnicamente as equipes das diversas frentes de trabalho da área de Geologia, buscando a otimização e produtividade durante a execução dos procedimentos de rotina e a boa interação com as demais áreas da empresa;
  • Controlar e acompanhar a produção de sondagem com foco no QAQC, garantindo a acuidade e qualidade da informação, de acordo com os procedimentos internos e normas de segurança, visando o atendimento às demandas da área;
  • Descrição dos Log´s de sondagem: litologias, estruturas, alteração hidrotermal e mineralizações, a fim de garantir a qualidade da informação que será utilizada nos processos subsequentes da cadeia de exploração mineral;
  • Gerar mapas e seções multitemáticas, as quais constituem itens essenciais na caracterização e avaliação das áreas de pesquisa/frentes de lavra, visando à confiabilidade dos resultados e o atendimento aos padrões de qualidade definidos pela Empresa.
  • Orientar e acompanhar os trabalhos de pesquisa mineral junto ao corpo técnico (técnicos e auxiliares), a fim de que os procedimentos, organização e qualidade da informação estejam de acordo com as melhores práticas do mercado;
  • Executar e coordenar o desenvolvimento dos protocolos e sistemas de garantia de qualidade/controle de qualidade para todos os dados de exploração, visando a utilização da informação nos processos subsequentes de modelamento e estimativa de recursos/reservas;
  • Inserção e controle de informações no banco de dados, garantindo a organização e qualidade da informação, visando à confiabilidade dos resultados e o atendimento aos padrões de qualidade definidos pela Empresa;
  • Preparar relatórios, conforme necessário, sobre dados geológicos, modelos, parâmetros e riscos técnicos relacionados a pesquisa mineral e relatórios normativos, em atendimento a protocolos/exigências de órgão públicos/privados;
  • Colaborar para manter todos os conjuntos de dados de uma maneira eficiente, enquanto constrói e mantém um banco de dados para uso por vários departamentos e usuários, a fim de mantê-lo organizado e auditável (interna e externamente), visando à confiabilidade dos resultados e o atendimento aos padrões de qualidade definidos pela Empresa;

title: Cloud Solutions Engineer (Infrastructure) - BRA
description:
Cloud Solutions Engineer (Infrastructure)

Reports To: IT Manager

Department: Information Technology

Location: Hybrid – Bumenau, Brazil

About MTech Systems

At MTech Systems, our mission is to increase yield in protein production to help feed the growing world population—without compromising animal welfare or the planet. We build cloud-first software that delivers real-time data across the protein supply chain, empowering producers with insights to improve operations responsibly.

With over 200 employees globally and customers in 20+ countries, MTech Systems is a leader in live animal protein production performance management. Our U.S. headquarters is in Atlanta, GA, where we foster a collaborative, flexible, and mission-driven work culture.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with strong customer-facing experience to join our IT team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of cloud architecture, automation, and customer success. You’ll work closely with internal teams and external customers to design, deploy, and support scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud infrastructure—primarily in Microsoft Azure.

You’ll play a key role in modernizing our infrastructure, supporting SaaS deployments, and ensuring our customers have a seamless experience with our cloud-hosted solutions. This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong emphasis on communication, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure in Microsoft Azure to support customer-facing applications.
  • Collaborate with product, development, and customer success teams to ensure infrastructure meets customer needs and SLAs.
  • Lead cloud onboarding and deployment efforts for new customers, including infrastructure provisioning, networking, and security configuration.
  • Optimize cloud costs and performance through proactive analysis and automation.
  • Serve as a technical advisor to customers and internal stakeholders on cloud best practices, security, and architecture.
  • Document infrastructure designs, runbooks, and customer-specific configurations.
  • Provide Tier 3 support for cloud-related issues and participate in incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Stay current with emerging cloud technologies and recommend improvements to our cloud strategy.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure engineering or systems administration, with at least 2 years in a customer-facing or consulting role.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Azure , including Azure AD, networking, storage, and compute services.
  • Strong scripting skills in PowerShell , Bash , or Python .
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Administrator Associate .
  • Experience with hybrid cloud environments and legacy system integration.
  • Familiarity with customer onboarding , technical account management , or solution architecture .
  • Knowledge of security frameworks and compliance standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001).

Why Join Us?

  • Work on meaningful projects that support global food sustainability.
  • Collaborate with a passionate, international team.
  • Enjoy a flexible hybrid work environment and opportunities for growth.
  • Make a direct impact on customer success and product innovation.

EEO Statement

Integrated into our shared values is MTech’s commitment to diversity and equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. MTech aims to maintain a global inclusive workplace where every person is regarded fairly, appreciated for their uniqueness, advanced according to their accomplishments, and encouraged to fulfill their highest potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at MTech has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment.

title: Executive - Equipment Control
description:
Job Title: Executive – Equipment Control

Department: Operations

Reporting To: Manager – Operations

Direct Reports: N/A

Job Purpose:

The Executive – Equipment Control is responsible for overseeing container equipment inventory, ensuring effective coordination with depots and state agents, and maintaining accurate, real-time tracking of container movements. The role focuses on optimizing equipment utilization, planning asset allocation, resolving operational challenges, and supporting smooth logistics operations across Brazil and neighboring regions including Argentina, Uruguay, and Paraguay.

Main Tasks and Responsibilities:

Equipment Inventory Management & Planning

  • Maintain and update daily container equipment inventory statistics with high accuracy.
  • Monitor stock levels and prepare equipment allocation plans based on operational demand.
  • Analyze historical data and trends to optimize equipment availability and positioning.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure efficient equipment flow.

Depot & Vendor Coordination

  • Act as the primary liaison between container depots and state agents for equipment movements.
  • Coordinate with depot teams to track inbound and outbound container flows.
  • Resolve depot-related operational issues and monitor vendor performance to ensure service reliability.

Container Tracking & Documentation

  • Update and maintain container movement logs accurately in the tracking system.
  • Ensure data integrity and investigate discrepancies in equipment records.
  • Generate regular reports on equipment utilization, stock availability, and movement history.

Issue Resolution & Process Improvement

  • Identify and resolve equipment-related operational issues in a timely manner.
  • Work closely with Operations and Commercial teams to address inefficiencies in equipment allocation.
  • Propose process improvements to enhance tracking accuracy, turnaround time, and operational efficiency.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • Maintain 100% accuracy in daily equipment inventory records, with discrepancies below 0.5% per quarter – 25%
  • Submit equipment allocation plans within 24 hours, achieving at least 95% alignment with operational demand – 20%
  • Ensure 98% on-time execution of equipment movements with minimal escalations – 20%
  • Resolve 95% of reported equipment-related issues within 24 hours – 15%
  • Ensure 100% real-time container movement updates with zero data gaps – 20%

Key Interactions:

Internal: Finance, HR & Admin, Operations, Procurement, Commercial

External: Vendors, Banks, Auditors, Statutory Authorities

Education and Experience Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Maritime Studies, Logistics, or related field
  • Specialization in Supply Chain Management, Maritime Operations, or Business Management
  • Master’s degree is preferred

Certifications & Training:

  • Professional certifications in Supply Chain Management, Maritime Operations, or Logistics (preferred)
  • Training in equipment flow optimization, compliance, and data management

Language Requirements:

  • English – Fluent
  • Portuguese – Required
  • Spanish – Optional / Advantage

Background and Experience:

Work Experience:

  • Industry: Shipping, Logistics, Freight Forwarding
  • Role Exposure: Equipment Management, Fleet Control, Logistics Coordination
  • Experience Range: 4–6 years

Core Competencies (Level 1 – Grades A–D):

  • Integrity & Accountability – Organizes work effectively, prioritizes tasks, and takes ownership of responsibilities
  • Customer Focus – Understands customer needs and ensures service delivery meets expectations
  • Continuous Learning – Actively seeks feedback, training, and applies new knowledge
  • Collaboration & Communication – Communicates clearly and supports teamwork proactively
  • Agility – Adapts to change and manages evolving operational priorities effectively

Functional Competencies:

  • Equipment Control & Management – Expertise in container inventory, allocation, and equipment flow
  • Logistics Coordination – Strong understanding of equipment movement within shipping operations
  • Data Analysis & Reporting – Ability to generate and interpret utilization and stock reports
  • Regulatory Compliance – Knowledge of industry regulations related to equipment control
  • Technology & Automation – Experience with equipment tracking systems and inventory tools

Work Environment & Specific Requirements:

  • Office-based role with regular coordination with depots, terminals, and vendors
  • Occasional travel to depots and equipment facilities as required
  • Requires strong attention to detail, coordination skills, and operational discipline

title: Senior Applied Scientist
description:
Senior Applied Scientist (Remote – Brazil)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Location: Remote (Brazil) – São Paulo

Duration: Open-Ended

Job Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Applied Scientist to lead the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning solutions. In this role, you will influence the technical direction of the team, collaborate closely with Product and Engineering partners, and drive innovation across data-driven initiatives.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who combines strong technical expertise with leadership capabilities and a passion for building high-impact solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end development and deployment of Machine Learning models to solve complex business problems.
  • Write and maintain clean, efficient, scalable code following industry best practices.
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to extract insights and support data-informed decision-making.
  • Apply state-of-the-art ML methodologies, including deep learning and modern frameworks, to build robust models.
  • Take ownership of key system components and influence the broader technical strategy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to design deployable, production-ready ML solutions.
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers, fostering team expertise and growth.
  • Contribute to organizational technical leadership through patent filings and publications in top-tier venues.

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning.
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML and deep learning models in production at scale.
  • Deep understanding of ML best practices (A/B testing, pipelines, feature engineering, experiment design).
  • Strong knowledge of algorithms and techniques such as gradient boosting, deep neural networks, transformers, and optimization methods.
  • Experience in Computer Vision ; experience in Causal Inference is highly desirable.
  • Expertise with Python scientific libraries (NumPy, pandas, Polars) and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-Learn).
  • Strong data engineering skills and comfort working with large-scale datasets.
  • Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark).
  • Experience with cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Fluency in Python and SQL .

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, OR, or related fields.
  • Experience applying ML to real-world retail industry problems.
  • Familiarity with modern MLOps tools and pipelines .
  • Impact-driven mindset and commitment to delivering high-quality models.
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities with experience guiding or managing technical teams.

title: Senior Elixir Developer
description:
Who We Are Seeking:

We’re looking for a talented and experienced Elixir Backend Developer to join our international team and help design, build, and harden our agentic contracts execution layer —the platform where autonomous/agent-driven workflows orchestrate and execute contractual logic reliably, at scale. This role presents an excellent opportunity for those looking to work in a dynamic environment and be part of a high-performing international team, offering ample opportunities for growth and development in technical and interpersonal skills. You’ll work on resilient OTP services, job orchestration, stateful workflows, and observability to ensure correctness, auditability, and performance. We seek an energetic, driven, and articulate team player who is truly passionate about their work

Your Role and Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement Elixir/OTP services (GenServer, Supervision trees, Registries) that power contract execution and agentic workflows.
  • Own the lifecycle of long-running, event-driven workflows (timers, scheduling, compensations/Saga patterns, exactly-once/at-least-once semantics).
  • Develop secure APIs and integrations, rate limiting, and request budgets for agent calls.
  • Optimize performance (ETS, streams, batching, backpressure) and observability (tracing, metrics, structured logs).
  • Collaborate with Product and AI/Agent teams to translate requirements into deterministic, testable contract execution flows.
  • Write high-quality tests, migrations, and production-grade documentation.

Tech You’ll Use:

  • Elixir /OTP (GenServer, Supervisors, Applications), Phoenix (APIs), Ecto (PostgreSQL), Oban, OpenTelemetry/PromEx
  • Message brokers & streams: Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Container & cloud: Docker , Kubernetes , AWS/GCP/Azure
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions (or similar), feature flags, migrations & rollout strategies

Essential Qualifications:

  • 3+ years building production Elixir/OTP services (or 5+ years BE + 1–2 years Elixir with strong OTP fundamentals).
  • Deep understanding of concurrency, supervision strategies, and fault tolerance on the BEAM.
  • Solid experience with Ecto/MySQL , schema design, transactions, and migrations.
  • Practical knowledge of job orchestration (Oban or equivalent), idempotency, retries, and backpressure.
  • Proven track record in building and maintaining event-driven or workflow systems with strong correctness guarantees.
  • Comfortable with containerized deployments and CI/CD; you ship and you own.
  • Strong written and spoken English (daily collaboration in English).

Who We Are:

DevGrid is a top-tier software consulting company based in the UK, with a development hub in Brazil and operations spanning Europe and the US. We believe that world-class software can only be created by a motivated and enthusiastic team in an environment that fosters creativity and free thinking. Established in 2015, we aim to drive innovation and digital transformation by combining our robust business culture and exceptional engineers with forward-thinking business insights.

What We Offer:

  • Open and flexible time-off policy;

title: Controls Engineer
description:
Build the Future of Automation as a Robotics Controls Engineer

We’re looking for a Robotics Controls Engineer who’s ready to take the lead in designing, programming, and optimizing cutting-edge robotic automation systems. In this hands-on role, you’ll bring bespoke robotic solutions to life, developing advanced control algorithms, integrating real-time systems, and delivering precision, performance, and reliability across industrial robot applications.

You’ll work side by side with mechanical, electrical, and production teams to create fully integrated automation solutions from concept to commissioning. From running simulations and performance testing to solving complex control challenges, your expertise will directly shape innovative, high-impact systems used in real-world environments.

This is an exciting opportunity for a controls engineer with 3+ years of industrial robot programming experience, a deep passion for automation, and the drive to push the boundaries of what robotic systems can achieve. If you’re eager to make a tangible impact on next-generation robotics, and see your work in action, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and optimise control algorithms for bespoke robotic systems.
  • Design and integrate control systems for real-time operation, ensuring precise and efficient movement, sensing, and interaction.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including mechanical design engineers, control engineers, and the production teams, to ensure seamless integration into our bespoke robotic automation & control systems.
  • Conduct simulations and testing to validate control algorithms, mechanical design, manipulator suitability and optimise performance to meet cycle time commitments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve control system issues, ensuring smooth operation and reliability.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in robotics controls across multiple vendor platforms and identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.
  • Document design processes, specifications, and develop technical reports.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years experience with programming industrial robots is essential.
  • Strong background in robotics controls and demonstrated experience in developing control algorithms for robotic systems, experience with programming ABB robots is essential.
  • Familiarity and experience with robotic hardware platforms, PLC programming (Rockwell, Siemens, Omron etc), sensors, and actuators.
  • Solid understanding of control theory, including PID control, state-space control, and adaptive control.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex control system issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in cross functional teams.
  • Experience with industrial automation, machine vision, or motion planning is desirable.

Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Você atuará em um projeto de uma empresa de grande porte do ramo da beleza , com forte presença nacional no modelo de varejo e franquias. A atuação será focada no apoio a processos administrativos e operacionais relacionados à abertura, reforma, fechamento e movimentação de lojas , com interface constante entre franqueados, parceiros de TI e áreas internas.

Se você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia e quer crescer em um ambiente que valoriza autonomia, aprendizado contínuo e impacto real, a Hypesoft é o lugar certo para você. Candidate‑se e venha construir o futuro conosco!

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
About WSO2

Founded in 2005, WSO2 is the largest independent software vendor providing open-source API management, integration, and identity and access management (IAM) products. WSO2's products and platforms—including our next-gen internal developer platform, Choreo—empower organizations to leverage the full potential of APIs for secure delivery of digital services and applications, enabling thousands of enterprises in over 90 countries globally to drive their digital transformation journeys. Our open-source, API-first approach frees developers and architects from vendor lock-in, enabling rapid digital product creation. Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has over 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with nearly USD100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit to learn more. Follow WSO2 on LinkedIn and X (formerly Twitter).

About the Role

As a Site Reliability Engineer at WSO2, you'll be instrumental in both supporting our existing customers with their managed or private cloud deployments and initiating new deployments across leading cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP. Your mission will include ensuring the seamless operation, scalability, and security of WSO2 cloud services, alongside automating processes to boost both efficiency and reliability.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Deployment Setup and Management:
  • Lead the design and implementation of new cloud deployments, tailoring solutions to meet stakeholder requirements on platforms like Azure, AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes.
  • Optimize cloud architectures for scalability and cost-effectiveness, adhering to best practices for networking, security, and access controls.
  • Gain and maintain deep knowledge of cloud infrastructure providers to create robust solutions.
  • Automation and CI/CD:
  • Craft and manage automation scripts and infrastructure as code (IaC) with Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.
  • Deploy CI/CD pipelines to streamline software delivery, testing, and deployment processes, ensuring efficient version control and configuration management.
  • Managed Cloud Support:
  • Ensure the availability of the services by configuring system monitors and alerts and attending to critical alerts in a timely manner.
  • Offer continuous support and maintenance for existing deployments, monitoring system performance and swiftly resolving issues to maintain high availability and reliability.
  • Implement strategies for performance optimization and failure prevention, conducting thorough root cause analyses to avoid future issues.
  • Monitoring and Security:
  • Establish comprehensive monitoring and alerting systems to oversee customer deployments, setting thresholds for incident response.
  • Conduct regular security assessments and stay abreast of the latest threats and trends to fortify cloud environments against risks.
  • Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing:
  • Foster a collaborative environment with product developers, operations, and QA teams to enhance workflows and product quality.
  • Share knowledge and best practices, contributing to the team’s collective expertise through documentation, training, and mentorship.

Skills and Experience

  • Fluent in English.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Expertise in cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS and GCP.
  • Expertise in Linux, virtualization and containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • A solid understanding of networking, security principles, and compliance frameworks.
  • Proficiency in IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation), configuration management (Puppet, Chef, Helm), and scripting languages (Python, Bash, PowerShell).
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (Github Actions, Jenkins) and monitoring/logging tools (Prometheus, ELK stack, Splunk).
  • Exceptional problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills, coupled with a proactive, customer-centric mindset.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.

In Addition to a Competitive Compensation Package, WSO2 Offers:

  • A work culture and environment where we value both hard work AND flexibility.
  • A flexible vacation/leave plan that fits your needs.
  • Health, dental, and life insurance for you and your family.

Diversity Drives Innovation:

We've built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it's important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual's strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation; it also ensures that we can create superior experiences for our customers, partners, and employees worldwide. We value the diversity of our team regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran or marital status, and we do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

title: Logistics & 3PL Operations Specialist

  • Serve as the technical authority in high-value inventory control , establishing and maintaining rigorous protocols for IMEI/serial number tracking and reconciliation.

  • Ensure full regulatory compliance by maintaining flawless consistency between physical goods, information systems, and complex Brazilian tax documentation (NF-e, CT-e, MDF-e, etc.).

3. Project Management & Global Interface

  • Independently execute and drive key strategic logistics projects (e.g., major WMS/ERP system rollouts, warehouse network expansion) from planning through implementation.
  • Interface directly with the local Chinese team and Global Headquarters to align local operations with global supply chain strategy, acting as the primary subject matter expert in Brazil.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Accounting, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical field.
  • Advanced English is mandatory (daily use).
  • Chinese is desirable.
  • 5+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in Warehouse Management, 3PL Operations, or Logistics roles, with a proven track record of driving process ownership and high-impact results.

Technical Expertise

  • Expert-level mastery of Brazilian logistics and tax legislation (NF-e, CT-e, MDF-e, ICMS).
  • Advanced proficiency in WMS, TMS, and integrated ERP systems.
  • Demonstrated deep experience in managing and controlling high-volume, serialized inventory (IMEI/serial numbers).

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Machine Learning Engineer to join our innovative and dynamic team.

Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Brazil - Remote

Industry: IT & Services.

This position requires advanced communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

Machine Learning Engineer | About You

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you are responsible for turning complex data and business challenges into scalable, high‑impact AI solutions. You thrive in environments where experimentation meets engineering rigor, and you take pride in building systems that work reliably in the real world. You are the kind of person who enjoys staying ahead of industry trends—especially in LLMs and generative AI—and bringing that knowledge into practical, production-ready workflows. You’re excited by the opportunity to shape modern ML pipelines end‑to‑end, collaborate deeply with cross-functional teams, and continuously refine how AI drives value across an organization.

Machine Learning Engineer | Day-to-Day

  • Develop and maintain scalable, reproducible machine learning pipelines across preprocessing, training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Build and optimize LLM-based solutions, including RAG approaches, embeddings, and semantic search capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to translate business needs into strong ML/AI system designs.
  • Prototype and deploy ML and deep learning models for transformation, ranking, prediction, and other applied use cases.
  • Design native workflows on AWS using Lambda, Step Functions, SageMaker, Bedrock, AgentCore, and related services.
  • Implement observability and monitoring tools to ensure reliability, stability, and compliance of models in production.

Machine Learning Engineer | Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Machine Learning, with a proven track record deploying end‑to‑end ML/AI systems in production.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS AI/ML services including SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda, and Step Functions, along with MLOps best practices.
  • Strong knowledge of LLMs, RAG architectures, embeddings, and vector databases.
  • Proficiency in Python and ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch and scikit‑learn, familiarity with transformer-based models.
  • Solid understanding of model deployment, containerization, and monitoring.
  • Experience with data engineering for ML workflows (feature pipelines, schema versioning, data quality controls).
  • Advanced English proficiency for communication with a global, distributed team.

title: Senior .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Contractor)

Job Type: Full-time (Remote)

Pay: R$20,000.00 – R$22,000.00 per month

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps . You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews , expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).

2. Testing & Quality

  • Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.

How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

title: Vaga para Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior (PJ) - Topshare
description:
ATENÇÃO: REQUISITO OBRIGATÓRIO

APENAS CANDIDATOS COM EXPERIÊNCIA SÓLIDA E COMPROVADA EM NODE.JS DEVEM SE CANDIDATAR.

CANDIDATURAS SEM ESTES REQUISITOS SERÃO DESCONSIDERADAS.

SOBRE A TOPSHARE E O ECOSSISTEMA CREATONOMY

A Topshare é uma plataforma de tecnologia que atua no coração da creator economy, sendo parte do grupo Creatonomy. Buscamos um profissional para atuar na arquitetura, desenvolvimento, manutenção e aprimoramento da plataforma Topshare, além de participar ativamente na criação da plataforma Creatonomy e em outros projetos estratégicos do grupo. O foco é em soluções escaláveis e de alta performance para todo o ecossistema.

Operamos em um ambiente de trabalho totalmente remoto, valorizando a flexibilidade, a inovação e a excelência técnica.

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Atuar como referência técnica em arquitetura backend, liderando a concepção e a implementação de soluções robustas, escaláveis e de alta performance. O profissional será responsável por garantir a robustez, a escalabilidade e a alta disponibilidade dos sistemas, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em arquiteturas sólidas e eficientes, com foco na stack Node.js (Backend).

RESPONSABILIDADES E ESCOPO DE ATIVIDADES

1. DESENVOLVIMENTO DE BACKEND E ARQUITETURA

Projetar, desenvolver e manter APIs e microsserviços robustos e escaláveis, utilizando a stack Node.js com NestJS (framework obrigatório), para a Topshare e para a plataforma Creatonomy. Isso inclui a modelagem, gestão e otimização de dados em bancos Neo4j (obrigatório) e MongoDB (desejável), garantindo a integridade e a alta disponibilidade do sistema. O profissional deverá contribuir ativamente para a definição da arquitetura de microsserviços e a evolução contínua da stack tecnológica. Será obrigatório o uso de Docker para empacotamento e execução dos serviços em ambientes isolados.

2. DEFINIÇÃO DE PADRÕES E ARQUITETURA

Estabelecer padrões de desenvolvimento, arquitetura de software e boas práticas para o backend. Será responsável por revisar e validar decisões arquiteturais, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e manutenibilidade dos sistemas. Deverá propor e implementar melhorias contínuas na infraestrutura e processos de CI/CD.

3. QUALIDADE DE CÓDIGO E TESTES

Utilizar Git e seguir rigorosamente as boas práticas de Git Flow, realizando pull requests e code reviews de forma contínua para assegurar a qualidade do código. Será responsável por implementar testes unitários com Jest, testes de integração e testes de carga para garantir a resiliência do sistema. Além disso, deverá atuar como referência técnica, compartilhando conhecimento e propondo melhorias na arquitetura e nos processos de CI/CD.

4. DISPONIBILIDADE PARA INCIDENTES CRÍTICOS

O Contratado se compromete a responder e atuar na correção de erros, bugs ou falhas críticas de produção em tempo hábil, fora do horário comercial, quando a indisponibilidade do sistema impactar diretamente a operação ou a receita da Contratante. Esta atuação é inerente à natureza do serviço de alta disponibilidade e não configura controle de jornada.

REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS

• Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Backend, com foco em sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis

• Proficiência em Node.js

• Experiência OBRIGATÓRIA com NestJS (framework Node.js para desenvolvimento de aplicações escaláveis)

• Experiência OBRIGATÓRIA com testes unitários utilizando Jest

• Experiência OBRIGATÓRIA com Neo4j (Banco de Dados Orientado a Grafos)

• Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e padrões de design

• Experiência sólida com Docker e conceitos de conteinerização

• Conhecimento e aplicação de boas práticas de versionamento com Git

• Experiência em design e otimização de APIs RESTful e/ou GraphQL

INFORMAÇÕES DA VAGA

Regime de Contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)

Remuneração: R$ 12.000,00/mês

Local: Remoto

Horário de Trabalho: De segunda a sexta-feira, em horário comercial
